title: Parameter - Attribute Double Quoted
description: The parameter is echoed in an HTML attribute, double quoted. i.e. <div data-value="%q">. The attacker must first break out of the double quotes.
objectives: Break out of the double-quoted attribute value.
Inject a new event handler attribute after escaping the quotes.
Understand how quoting affects the difficulty of attribute-based XSS.
hints: You need a double quote to close the attribute, then inject new attributes.
